compiled_state.title: [GREEN] Create WCAG 2.2 AAA corpus files in accessibility domain
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

Create YAML corpus files in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/accessibility/ covering all four WCAG 2.2 principles at AAA level with Section 508/OMB M-24-08 cross-references. Update _index.yaml.

## testing_mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] accessibility/ directory created with YAML files for all 4 WCAG 2.2 principles (Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust)
- [ ] Each file has: rule_id, prior_art (w3.org/TR/WCAG22/ URL), precedence, domain: accessibility, compliance: [wcag-2.2-aaa], appropriate action: tags
- [ ] Detail tier quotes normative WCAG 2.2 SC text verbatim from W3C spec
- [ ] Summary tier provides practical implementation note
- [ ] Section 508/OMB M-24-08 cross-references noted where applicable
- [ ] Keyboard navigation entries tagged with action: [keyboard-nav]
- [ ] license field set to W3C-Document or equivalent
- [ ] No file exceeds 500 lines
- [ ] check-corpus-schema passes on all accessibility/ files
- [ ] ref-query returns top result with compliance:[wcag-2.2-aaa] AND action:[keyboard-nav] for query 'WCAG 2.2 keyboard navigation'
- [ ] _index.yaml updated with all new entries
- [ ] All tests in test_corpus_accessibility_wcag.py pass (GREEN)

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: All 4 principles, AAA level, Section 508 cross-refs, Summary+Detail tiers, <=500 lines
- DD2: keyboard-nav entries have action:[keyboard-nav] tag
- DD3: _index.yaml updated, schema valid
- DD4: ref-query precision query returns correct result

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/accessibility/perceivable-wcag22-aaa.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/accessibility/operable-wcag22-aaa.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/accessibility/understandable-wcag22-aaa.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/accessibility/robust-wcag22-aaa.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/accessibility/keyboard-navigation-wcag22.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_index.yaml [UPDATE]
